channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Expertise Can’t Be Automated: Why Resilience Still Needs Humans
item.description: Abby Wambach, Neil Peart, Kelsey Hightower. These people are all experts in their relevant fields. Through them we recognize expertise as an exceptionally high (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: Respecting fatigue isn’t coddling
item.description: Most companies don't recognize the impact that responder fatigue (especially after overnight incidents) has on next-day performance, for both normal work and further incidents. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: On building scalable control planes
item.description: Zak van der Merwe has spent his entire career at AWS building control planes. First for EC2 and now for DSQL. On the surface, the control plane looks quite boring: it records what should exist and reconciles that with what actually does. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: Mario Saved the EU but Broke My System
Certificate Expiry Is Still Taking Down Major Platforms
item.description: Tailscale, jsDelivr, ServiceNow, and IPinfo went down after certificate renewals failed silently. Learn what monitoring missed and how CertOps closes the gap. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: How Stripe uses graph search and state machines to auto-remediate a global database fleet
item.description: Discover how we modeled our MongoDB infrastructure as a traversable graph and then use pathfinding algorithms to dynamically compute and execute recovery plans. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: Grafana's gcx and MCP Server Reach GA for Telemetry-Driven Agent Development
item.description: Grafana Labs has announced general availability for two tools that let AI coding agents query live observability data during development: the gcx CLI and the Grafana MCP server. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: From Thousands to One: Building LLM-Powered Selection Systems
item.description: Jendrik Jördening shares practical engineering strategies for integrating LLMs into production pipelines. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Monitoring SystemD services with Healthchecks.io
item.description: Outlines how to use healthchecks.io and systemd’s OnSuccess and OnFailure hooks to ping the status of a service. (1 source: lobsters)
